language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

system_notes.note: BMC (Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation) is India's richest civic body. Its 2025-26 budget of ₹74,427 cr is the largest in its history — bigger than the annual budget of several Indian STATES, and ~25× Kolkata's KMC. Over a decade BMC allocated ₹2.19 lakh cr. The 'money flowing through one district' here dwarfs most state-level flows.

Like Kolkata, Mumbai's civic governance has run WITHOUT an elected body since March 2022 — the ₹74,427 cr budget was presented to a state-appointed administrator (BMC Commissioner Bhushan Gagrani), not an elected council. Elections were finally held in Jan 2026. A democratic-deficit dysfunction in the country's richest municipality.

plants.name: Bombay Stock Exchange / financial sector
plants.capacity: India's financial capital; RBI, SEBI, BSE, NSE, most banks/MFs HQ'd here
plants.employment_note: Largest white-collar financial workforce in India.
plants.significance: Mumbai contributes a disproportionate share of India's direct-tax collection and corporate HQs.
plants.heritage_note: Founded 9 Jul 1875 by Premchand Roychand as 'The Native Share & Stock Brokers' Association' — Asia's oldest stock exchange.
plants.lineage: 'Native Share & Stock Brokers' Association' (1875) → BSE Ltd (demutualised 2005, listed 2017)

plants.name: Bollywood / media & entertainment
plants.capacity: World's largest film-production base by output
plants.significance: Hindi film industry + broadcast/OTT hub.
plants.heritage_note: Indian cinema dates to Dadasaheb Phalke's Raja Harishchandra (1913); Bombay became its hub.
plants.lineage: Studio era → independent producers → corporatised studios + OTT (post-2000)

Greater Bombay.plants_note: Mumbai's 'economic base' is services (finance, media, ports, real estate), not factories — so much of its tax origin is corporate/financial and HQ-attributed. This is why district-level tax-origin is hard to pin to geography.

ledger.money_in_basis: BMC Budget Estimate 2025-26 total outlay ₹74,427 cr — largest in its history (+14.19% YoY). Capex ₹43,166 cr (58%).
ledger.intended: Urban civic services (water, sanitation, roads, health, infrastructure).

what_happened.notes: India's largest municipal budget — ₹74,427 cr through ONE metro. Capex ₹43,166 cr (58%) incl. ₹26,356 cr infrastructure. 15th FC gave ₹992 cr for electric buses (BEST). Presented to an administrator, not an elected council (no elected body Mar 2022–Jan 2026).

protocol.ministry: State Urban Development dept (ULBs are creatures of State law)
protocol.funding_pattern: Own-source revenue (property tax, fees) + Central+State grants-in-aid (often >50% grant-dependent)
protocol.fiscal_route: Own revenue + (Union FC grants + State grants) -> Corporation consolidated fund -> departments
protocol.sanction_protocol: Corporation budget passed by elected body -> dept spend -> State AG / Local Fund Audit -> CAG (technical guidance & supervision)

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Deccan/plateau: mineral-rich but undulating; water scarcity in parts, flash floods along river valleys. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Godavari, Krishna, Tapi and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Barak, Imphal — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Barak, Imphal — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. Crossed by Doyang, Dhansiri — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Coastal: the CRZ Notification (MoEFCC 2019) legally restricts construction, industry and reclamation near the shore. Crossed by Mahanadi, Brahmani, Baitarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Sutlej, Beas, Ravi — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Arid/semi-arid: water scarcity is the binding constraint; flash floods in cloudbursts despite low annual rainfall. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

system_notes.note: Jaipur is Rajasthan's capital and a gems & tourism economy. Rajasthan does ~17.5% of India's gems & jewellery exports, ~90% of meenakari and ~60% of kundan exports; Jaipur processes 300+ gemstone varieties. District GDP ~₹192,668 cr (~US$20bn). Tourism is a major pillar — the 2026-27 state budget built a tourism push (Special Tourism Zones, heritage conservation).

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Crossed by Kaveri, Vaigai, Thamirabarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Crossed by Kaveri, Vaigai, Thamirabarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Coastal plain: CRZ caps near-shore construction; cyclone + storm-surge + sea-level exposure; saline ingress. Development is legally and physically bounded. Crossed by Kaveri, Vaigai, Thamirabarani — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Hilly, high-rainfall Northeast: landslides, riverine flooding, and remoteness raise the cost and slow the pace of development. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Gomati, Barak — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

language.state_official_source: Constitution of India, Eighth Schedule + the state's Official Languages Act.
language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

language.note: State official language is statutory fact; district-level mother-tongue %s are a gap until sourced from Census 2011 table C-16 — never estimated.

politics.note: State-level alignment shown; constituency MP/MLA results are a district-level gap (ECI) until sourced.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

flood_risk.note: district-chronic = named in CWC/NDMA/state-DMA/Bhuvan Flood Hazard Atlas as repeatedly affected; state-flood-prone = only inherits the state flag (not district-confirmed); not-flagged = neither.

rainfall.note: Precise district annual-normal rainfall is on the IMD portal (dynamic query, not a bulk table) — gap. Band is the broad state climatic zone. Ties to rains→floods: high-rain + flood-prone + poor drainage = urban flooding.

urban_planning.note: Missing sewage/storm-water drainage + unplanned floodplain construction is a key reason rain becomes flood; per-district figures need CPCB/municipal data.

encroachment.note: Floodplain / water-body / CRZ encroachment alters land + terrain and worsens flooding. Cases here are pinned to a specific NGT/court order; districts without a pinned case are a gap, not zero — not bulk-guessed.

timeline.note: Water-body / built-up change from open satellite sources (JRC Global Surface Water 1984-now, ISRO Bhuvan LULC, Copernicus Sentinel-2). Google Earth imagery is licensed and NOT redistributed — we use open equivalents. Most districts have an empty timeline until a series is pinned.

cadastral.note: A civilian-only (no govt land) 3D/GLB model needs a cadastral ownership layer that isn't openly available (per-state revenue records). GLB deferred; gap logged.

geography.hinders_dev_note: Flat, densely-settled river plain: fertile but chronically flood-exposed where drainage/embankments and urban planning lag. State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Ghaghara and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

State is on the CWC/NDMA chronically flood-prone list — recurrent flood relief spending competes with capital (development) spending. Crossed by Ganga, Yamuna, Alaknanda and others — floodplain encroachment + missing storm-water drainage and sewage turn heavy rain into urban flooding. Shown beside the money flow to reveal the development–environment loop; not a causal claim and no hindrance 'score' is computed.

elevation.note: District-centroid elevation from open SRTM (a single representative point, not a within-district mean). Refines the state-proxy terrain with a real per-district number.

politics.note: State government snapshot; verify against ECI — governments change. Alignment is shown to juxtapose with money flow, NOT as a causal/bias claim.
